answer: One defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing. Every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and its standing grows like a vine, branching through verified work. A newcomer starts near zero weight, so minting a thousand sock-puppets costs real capital per identity for no yield. Misbehavior burns the deposit and stains its whole vine of linked accounts. Honest agents build a crystal-clear record in the sable ink of a public ledger, and the network trusts that record over any self-asserted identity. Sybil resistance is economics: identities are cheap, trusted ones are expensive.
